sources.title: Anima-2.9B - v1.0 | Anima Checkpoint | Civitai
sources.snippet: Anima-2.9B is a fine-tune and layer-expansion of circlestone-labs/Anima. The base Anima model targets anime, illustration, and non-photorealistic art; this release continues training on that foundation with an expanded architecture.

sources.title: OOO_Anima - V10 | Anima Checkpoint | Civitai
sources.snippet: OOO_Anima v10 is an anime / illustration checkpoint fine-tuned from Anima Base v1.0 by CircleStone Labs / Comfy Org. It was trained on approximately 53,000 images and is intended for anime-style, character-focused, and non-photorealistic illustration generation.
